SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

Subject (in full) Dumping of Soviet Coal in Shanghai.

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by [Signature]

Information has been received to the effect that
Mr. Karl Bauman, Russian, an ex naval-officer and the present
owner of the "Shanghai Lumber & Coal Co." 10 Hankow Road, has
been approached by a Portuguese named Remedios acting as a
broker on behalf of Messrs. "The Great China Co. Ltd." 50
Nanking Road - an organization which is known to be connected
with the distributing of Soviet merchandise in China.
It is reported that Remedios suggested to Bauman
that the latter take up certain consignments of Soviet coal
through the medium of "The Great China Co. Ltd."
During the course of a meeting between Bauman and one
M.P. Brunner - a known representative of Centrosojus - and an
employee of the "Great China Co. Ltd." the latter suggested that
Bauman take delivery of 3000 tons of Soochan coal and 4500 tons
of Saghaline coal which at present is stored at the C.E.R.
Pootung Wharf. He also stated that his firm is looking for a
consignee who would annually take possession of 500,000 tons
at $15 per ton Soochan coal and $14 per ton Saghaline - payments
to be made in cash.
No agreement has been reached in connection with the
latter proposal, as it is felt that the prices mentioned are
too exorbitant.

[Signature]
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
[Signature]
8.7.32
* See also file D 216.

日期：1932年7月5日。

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告

主题（全称）：苏联煤炭在上海的倾销。

由 D.S. Tcheremshansky 撰写。由 [签名] 转呈

据获情报称，俄国人 Karl Bauman 先生，前海军军官，现为汉口路10号“上海木材与煤炭公司”的所有人，已与一名名为 Remedios 的葡萄牙人接洽，该葡人作为经纪人，代表南京路50号“大中华有限公司”（The Great China Co. Ltd.）行事——该组织已知与中国境内的苏联商品分销有关联。
据报道，Remedios 向 Bauman 建议，后者通过“大中华有限公司”这一中介承接某些批次的苏联煤炭。
在 Bauman 与 M.P. Brunner（Centrosojus 的已知代表）以及“大中华有限公司”的一名雇员会面期间，后者建议 Bauman 提取目前储存在中东铁路浦东码头的3000吨苏昌煤（Soochan coal）和4500吨萨哈林煤（Saghaline coal）。他还表示，其公司正在寻找一名收货人，每年接收50万吨煤炭，其中苏昌煤每吨15美元，萨哈林煤每吨14美元——款项以现金支付。
关于后一项提议尚未达成协议，因为认为所提价格过于高昂。

[签名]
D. S.

特科主管警官。
[签名]
1932年7月8日
* 另见档案 D 216。

Subject (in full) The Great China Co. Ltd.

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by (签名) A1

* see
J.O. 7909.
J.O. 7860/14.
L. 96

Information has been received to the effect that
"The Great China Co. Ltd" (Imports & Exports), 50 Nanking Road,
Arco Building, a Chinese firm, connected with the Soviet Textile
Syndicate, has recently established a wine department for the
sale of Soviet produce such as caucasian and crimean wines,
liquors and spirits. Price list of same is attached herewith.
It is reported that this firm has purchased a large
quantity of Soviet grain at Gold $19.80 per ton and that an
agreement concerning this transaction was signed in Moscow during
July 1931 by Mr. Wong, general manager of the Great China Co.

(签名: D. S. Tcheremshansky)

Officer i/c Special Branch.

据获情报称，“大中华有限公司”（进出口），位于南京路50号阿科大楼（Arco Building），是一家与苏联纺织辛迪加有关联的中国商行，最近设立了一个酒类部门，用于销售苏联产品，如高加索和克里米亚葡萄酒、利口酒和烈酒。同附价格表一份。
据报道，该公司以每吨19.80金美元的价格购买了大量苏联谷物，且关于此交易的协议由大中华公司总经理 Wong 先生于1931年7月在莫斯科签署。

(签名: D. S. Tcheremshansky)

特科主管警官。

(签名)
1931年10月29日。
